name: Flowsparks
description_en:
FLOWSPARKS is an e-learning product family covering content authoring, AI-assisted drafting, LMS delivery and FastPass access. The authoring tool and LMS serve different parts of the learning process.

A buyer should decide whether the need is to create learning materials, distribute and report on them, or provide quick access for people without company email. These are not automatically one identical subscription.
description_zh:
FLOWSPARKS 是包含内容创作、AI 辅助起草、LMS 交付和 FastPass 访问的电子学习产品家族，创作工具与 LMS 负责不同环节。

采购应先确定需要制作教材、分发并跟踪教材，还是让没有公司邮箱的人快速访问。这些并非自动属于同一种订阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Create and localize learning modules with instructional templates.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用教学模板创建并本地化学习模块。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage users, content and reporting rights in the LMS offering.
core_features.explanation_zh: LMS 产品管理用户、内容及报告权限。

core_features.explanation_en: A separate access offering targets people without company email.
core_features.explanation_zh: 独立访问产品面向没有公司邮箱的人。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 创作、LMS 与 FastPass 的边界
sections.en: The Authoring Tool uses learning templates and translation/localization functions; AI Co-Author creates drafts from supplied resources. The LMS is described as managing users, content and reporting rights. FastPass is positioned for sharing digital modules with workers or external collaborators without email addresses. A content-creation capability does not itself establish an organization-wide learner-management entitlement.
sections.zh: Authoring Tool 使用学习模板及翻译本地化功能，AI Co-Author 根据资料生成草稿。LMS 用于管理用户、内容和报告权限。FastPass 则面向没有邮箱的员工或外部协作者分享数字模块。具备内容创作能力，并不意味着同时获得全机构学员管理权益。

sections.title_en: Example: convert a procedure into a learning module
sections.title_zh: 示例：把操作规程转成学习模块
sections.en: Give a subject expert an approved procedure, choose an appropriate learning template and draft a short module with a knowledge check. Review every instruction and translation before distribution. Then pilot the intended LMS or FastPass access route and inspect what identifies the learner and what evidence is recorded. A quick access flow is useful only if its identity and reporting behavior meets the training requirement. No module was built here.
sections.zh: 由主题专家提供已批准规程，选择合适学习模板，编写含知识检查的短模块。分发前逐条检查步骤与译文，再试点目标 LMS 或 FastPass 访问链路，确认如何识别学员及记录哪些证据。快速访问只有在身份和报告符合培训要求时才有意义。本文未实际搭建模块。

sections.en: The pricing page asks readers to get in touch for a plan and offers a free demonstration; no cash amount or billing unit appears in the retrieved page. Ask separately about author seats, learners, AI usage, FastPass, LMS integration, translations and professional services. A free demo does not establish ongoing free use, and the advertised creation-speed multiplier was not independently measured.
sections.zh: 定价页要求联系获取方案，并提供免费演示，本次读取没有现金金额或计费单位。应分别询问作者席位、学员、AI 用量、FastPass、LMS 集成、翻译和专业服务。免费演示不能证明持续免费使用，宣传的创作速度倍数也未经独立测量。

sections.title_en: Keep instructional review and operating ownership
sections.title_zh: 保留教学审核和运营负责人
sections.en: Start with one module and one target audience. Confirm publishing/update behavior in the chosen delivery environment and test interrupted access or a failed check. FLOWSPARKS may fit learning teams collaborating with subject experts; a team that only needs a file repository has a narrower problem. Exact format interoperability, source licensing, offline behavior, hosting location and restoration guarantees were not verified.
sections.zh: 从一个模块和一类目标人群开始，确认所选交付环境的发布更新行为，并检查访问中断或考核失败。它可能适合与主题专家协作的培训团队，仅需文件仓库的团队需求更窄。具体格式互通、源码许可、离线行为、托管位置和恢复保证未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Confirm product bundle, learner identity under FastPass, format interoperability, AI usage and deployment rights.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认产品组合、FastPass 学员身份、格式互通、AI 用量和部署权。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
